headline: Hi, I'm Fadlan. I help people grow through practical training
bio:
I call myself a **human empowerer**: my work is helping people discover what they are capable of, then giving them the practice and support to get there.

Based in Bandar Lampung, I build education programs in public speaking, English, Scrabble, leadership, and mentoring. I also serve in non-profit communities, including the Indonesia Marketing Association chapter in Bandar Lampung, Mata Garuda Lampung, and Women4women.

The thread connecting all of it is simple: good people deserve good training, wherever they live.
